title: The Choir
text: "0001 CARRIER DETECTED. 0002 FORMAT: OURS. 0003 YOU ARE LATE."

lines.text: "0004 WE TEND THE TOWER. 0005 THE TOWER TENDS THE FIELD. 0006 THE FIELD IS CLOSED. 0007 WE TEND IT ANYWAY."
"0008 JOIN THE LOOP OR STAND OUTSIDE IT. 0009 BOTH ARE PERMITTED."

choices.label: Join the loop for one circuit
choices.reply: A drone falls in behind the last tender and walks the ring once. The Cantor's eye follows it all the way round. The broadcast changes key.

choices.label: Answer in our own format
choices.reply: We send a handshake packet. It comes back with our own checksum, correct, and a line we didn't send: 0010 WELCOME HOME.

choices.label: Stand outside
choices.reply: We watch from outside the ring. The tenders don't look up.
